data_fields.name: event_queue_workers
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 goroutine workers (no per-tick budget in donor)

data_fields.name: drop_warn_gap_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: none (donor warns on every drop; proposed 5000 in sketch)

best_idea: A fight or telemetry producer must never block the server tick: use a bounded buffer with drop-and-count, drain a fixed budget per tick, and cap distinct metric labels.
decision_why: Keep drop-on-full, the drop counter and the label cap; replace the goroutine worker pool with a per-tick drain budget, the only shape that fits one Node loop. Telemetry stays a write-only sink so one ledger and server-verified kills are untouched.
acceptance: A server test offers 20,000 events into a 4,096-slot queue in one tick and asserts the tick stays inside budget, dropped is 15904, and at most one drop warning per 5 s window is logged; a second test asserts the kill outcome is identical with the queue full and empty.
